name: Fruit Splash Mania
summary: Fruit Splash Mania is a line‑drawing match‑puzzle game developed by Storm8 / TeamLava, offering an addictive blend of strategy and timing. As you link together fruits like lemons, berries, and watermelons, you build combos that earn high scores. With over 300 levels spread across diverse themed environments, the game challenges you to master five fun game modes, navigate tricky obstacles, and use smart power-ups to earn three stars on every level. Social features and reward systems like leaderboards, keys, gems, and boosts add depth and replayability. The experience is enhanced by colorful graphics, engaging animations, and smooth performance.
